verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents several model and mode choices: Realtime vs Batch processing, domain-specialized models such as finance and medical, and on its pricing page a multilingual model and a clinical-language model. The evidence never shows published per-model accuracy, latency, or cost tradeoffs; the accuracy comparisons are against competitors, not between its own models. missing for 10: published per-model accuracy/WER figures, per-model latency figures, per-model cost tradeoffs, a consolidated model-selection guide, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: Request a specialized model based on 'language' but optimized for a particular field, e.g. finance or medical.
For transcription of clinical language: drug names, dosages, abbreviations and procedure terms, with full multilingual support.
Transcribes 56 languages without choosing one up front, switches language mid-sentence.
Instantly convert streaming audio to text with Realtime processing
Use Batch processing to accurately turn your audio files into text
